summary: Agent roster owners consume indexed claim and local-observation intervals instead of refreshing after every global notification. Metadata-only commits must invalidate the retained roster before owner admission. Summary machine counts update changed peer transport evidence without rebuilding runtime membership on every successful replication exchange.

replay.detail: No replay. Input cursors and retained machine contributions initialize from authoritative source snapshots and reset with existing projection invalidation.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or public client protocol changes. The performance report adds agent_roster_wake_work cause counters and summary_work.machine_membership_rebuilds.

rules.detail: Roster freshness, explicit requests, demand, delivery evidence, local harness observations, subagents and exact evidence deadlines remain inputs. Ignored metadata notifications cannot postpone a pending evidence deadline. Peer reachability and receipt resets retain native summary semantics.

compatibility.detail: Retains all attention, summary, roster, reconciliation, fault-family and relayed-close performance counters. Builds on the earlier attention-source retention and future-prompt runtime-stop fix; bounds the remaining delivery state-clock incarnation history using the same recipient retirement lifecycle.

manual.detail: Deterministic work-count regressions cover unrelated metadata and claim commits, relevant runtime and local observations, reset invalidation, absolute deadline preservation, peer receipt updates without runtime membership reconstruction, transport authority, receipt resets, and delivery incarnation churn. Measure settled background CPU after deployment; unit work counts do not establish the CPU target.

recovery.detail: Projection resets or regressed peer receipts rebuild their authoritative retained source. No debounce, periodic refresh, timeout enlargement or failed-path retry was introduced.
